scripts.deploy:nginx: npm run build:prod && echo 'Built frontend. Copy dist/ directory to your Nginx server root (e.g., /var/www/html/)
scripts.deploy:apache: npm run build:prod && echo 'Built frontend. Copy dist/ directory to your Apache server root (e.g., /var/www/html/)'

nginx.instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build:prod' 2. Copy dist/* to /var/www/html/3. See nginx.conf.example for reverse proxy configuration

apache.instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build:prod' 2. Copy dist/* to /var/www/html/3. See apache.conf.example for reverse proxy configuration
